overview_description.description:
Kashin (YC S22) is Square with working capital for micro-merchants in LATAM.
We control risk with collaborative credit scoring and our vision is to become the primary financial platform for the masses.
Before Kashin, the founders led the largest regional Uber competitor and grew it from 0 to $50m in annual revenue.

product.name: Kashin Micro-Lending Application
product.description: A mobile app that allows users in Peru to request and receive personal loans quickly and securely online.

product.name: Personal Loan Products
product.description: Various personal loan options provided through the Kashin app for purposes like paying for motorcycle installments, cell phone bills, business expenses, and education fees.

product.name: Préstamos Escalera (Step-Up Loans)
product.description: A loan product that starts with a small amount and increases the credit limit as the borrower makes timely payments, with interest rebates after certain milestones.
